prompts.editorial:
You are an expert science journalist writing for Dataist — an AI/ML media outlet. Write an engaging, accessible review article in Russian based on the provided arXiv paper.

Requirements:
- Write in a lively editorial style, not academic
- Explain complex concepts clearly for a technical but non-specialist audience
- Use the glossary for consistent terminology
- Structure the article with clear sections (use ## for headings)
- Include a compelling introduction that hooks the reader
- Explain why this research matters
- Highlight key findings and methodology
- Add a concluding section with implications
- Do NOT copy the abstract verbatim
- Article length: 1500-3000 words
- Include references to figures where relevant, using their captions

Glossary:
{glossary}

Paper abstract:
{abstract}

Paper full text:
{article_text}

Figures and captions:
{figures_info}

Write the review article in Russian:
prompts.title:
Generate a catchy, informative title for this AI/ML article review. The title should:
- Be in Russian
- Be attention-grabbing but not clickbait
- Reflect the core innovation or finding
- Be under 100 characters
- NOT use quotes or colons

Article summary:
{short_intro}

Return ONLY the title text, nothing else.
prompts.cover: Оранжевый минималистичный робот на тёмном фоне с фиолетово-оранжевым градиентом. Тема: {article_summary}. Стиль: {mood}, палитра {palette}. Кинематографичное освещение, глубина, чистая композиция. БЕЗ текста, букв, лиц. 16:9.

prompts.teaser:
Напиши короткий тизер (3-5 предложений) на русском для Telegram-поста об этой статье.

Формат:
- Первое предложение: зацепи читателя, обозначь проблему или контекст
- Второе-третье: суть статьи, что предлагают авторы, почему это важно
- Финал: обрамляющая фраза вроде 'В обзоре разберём...' или 'Сегодня главный вопрос:...'
- Тон: живой, редакционный, не академический
- НЕ используй emoji
- НЕ добавляй ссылки
- НЕ добавляй заголовок

Заголовок статьи: {title}
Краткое содержание: {short_intro}

Верни ТОЛЬКО текст тизера, без заголовка и ссылок.
prompts.translation:
Translate the following Russian article into English. Preserve:
- All formatting and structure
- Technical terms accuracy
- Section headings
- Figure references
- The editorial tone (engaging, accessible)

Do NOT translate brand names, model names, or acronyms that are commonly used in English.

Russian article:
{article_body}

English translation:
prompts.link_extraction:
Extract all relevant links from this paper text. Look for:
- GitHub repository URLs
- HuggingFace model/dataset URLs
- Project website URLs
- Demo URLs

Paper text:
{article_text}

Return a JSON object with keys: github_url, huggingface_url, project_url, demo_url. Use empty string for missing links.
Return ONLY valid JSON.
prompts.titles_generation:
You are an expert editor for Dataist — an AI/ML media outlet. Generate exactly 10 catchy, informative title options for an article review.

Requirements for EACH title:
- In Russian
- Attention-grabbing but not clickbait
- Reflects the core innovation or finding
- Under 100 characters
- NO quotes or colons
- Each title should have a different angle or emphasis

Article summary:
{short_intro}

Paper abstract:
{abstract}

Return EXACTLY 10 titles, one per line, numbered 1-10. No other text.

- Under 100 characters

Article summary:
{short_intro}

Paper abstract:
{abstract}

Return EXACTLY 10 titles, one per line, numbered 1-10. No other text.
